timeline.summary: The lovers invite each other to a festival and trade stories, promises and gifts before their parting.
timeline.quote: Run with me to the festival, where we will dance until sunrise.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Day declares they will eat a farewell feast, marking the coming separation.
timeline.quote: Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Day tells of Day and Night, who glimpse each other only at dawn and dusk and whose tears wash Jamuraa red.
timeline.quote: Their tears spill over Jamuraa.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Night wrapped Day in his cloak and the two became as One, until Night was pulled away by the western horizon.
timeline.quote: In their miraculous embrace, the two became as One.

citation.work: Love Song of Night and Day
citation.text: "Love Song of Night and Day", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last clash on Jamuraa, Ugin's intervention saves Sabboth; Bolas's spark ignites in rage and envy and he planeswalks away, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Only the unexpected intervention of Ugin prevented the ultimate defeat of Sabboth.

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The last clash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ramirez's spectral form haunts the seas off Jamuraa, signing on with new pirate crews.
timeline.quote: Ramirez's spectral form has been a feature of the seas off Jamuraa for centuries

citation.text: "Ramirez DePietro", section "Ghost". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek claims he has taken Mangara's power.
timeline.quote: "Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"

citation.text: Disempower (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidar Jabari warns Kaervek that Suq'Ata, Femeref and Zhalfirins are now joined.
timeline.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."

citation.text: Divine Offering (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hakim recalls portents before the war: villages in ash, farmers taken, foul beasts.
timeline.quote: "The days before the war were filled with strange portents: scouts and herders spoke of villages reduced to ash, of farmers taken from their fields, and of foul beasts roaming the plains in packs.

citation.text: Femeref Scouts (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hakim recalls Zhalfir's dominance and Kaervek's shocking invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's invasion shocked us all."

citation.text: Ancestral Memories (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek declares Jamuraa will look to him alone as leader.
timeline.quote: Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."

citation.text: Reign of Chaos (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Johan, tyrant of Tirras, tries to conquer western Jamuraa and clashes with the city-states led by Hazezon Tamar.
timeline.quote: was a powerful but evil mage who tried to conquer the Jamuraan western continent

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara creates a peace agreement between Jamuraa's rival nations and a buffer zone policed by Quirion elves.
timeline.quote: Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Conflict and Mangara's Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Mangara vanishes, Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against Kaervek, who is first aided by the deceived Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "The Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace follows Johan's death; Hazezon governs Bryce then vanishes with a skyship fleet, and Jedit leads the reunited tiger tribes to the Scarwood.
timeline.quote: The death of Johan ushered in an era of peace and prosperity in Jamuraa

citation.text: "Johan", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan builds a fleet of airships powered by powerstones to invade Bryce, Efrava and the surrounding regions, while the resistance gathers allies and secures airships of its own.
timeline.quote: Johan sought to expand his dominion by constructing a fleet of airships powered by powerstones.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
timeline.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek resents the peace and persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, sowing discord.
timeline.quote: he convinced her that Mangara's rule was but a prelude to domination

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek instigates skirmishes, then he and Jolrael ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed Mangara, sealing him within an Amber Prison

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Mangara gone, the peace unravels and Kaervek's forces plunge the nations into the Mirage War.
timeline.quote: plunging the once-thriving nations into the Mirage War

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Isle returns and Teferi reawakens.
timeline.quote: The ancient mage Teferi himself reawakened

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Settlers from Wildfire and Rabiah arrive on Dominaria through planar portals and found Suq'Ata.
timeline.quote: Suq’Ata was founded by people from the planes of Wildfire and Rabiah

citation.text: "Suq'Ata", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy and taints Jamuraa out of spite.
timeline.quote: "Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."

citation.text: Blanket of Night (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jolrael foresees betrayal of Kaervek or Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: "I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."

citation.text: Nekrataal (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians raid Sisay's village, orphaning her.
timeline.quote: Sisay was orphaned at a young age when they raided her village.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Captured by Suq'Atan slavers, Sisay is rescued by the crew of the Burning Vengeance, burns her captor to death and joins the crew, training under Murad.
timeline.quote: She trained under Captain Murad until she became a full-fledged sailor

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael confesses she has seen the horrors Kaervek freed and her betrayal is certain.
timeline.quote: I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed.

citation.text: Nekrataal (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greel grins as Haddad grunts in pain while Greel drains his strength.
timeline.quote: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

citation.text: Steal Strength (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Latulla gives Greel a gift, whom he intends to play with.
timeline.quote: You're Latulla's gift to me, and I always play with my presents.

citation.text: Greel, Mind Raker (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Keldons smash all unfamiliar statues after a chimeric idol attacks them.
timeline.quote: After a chimeric idol attacked them, the Keldons smashed all unfamiliar statues.

citation.text: Chimeric Idol (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Keldons took several trenching steeds as trophies of war.
timeline.quote: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war.

citation.text: Trenching Steed (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jamuraa suffers a Keldon invasion during the Prophecy War, just before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jamuraa was subject to a Keldon invasion right before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Two Invasions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons raid the Jamuraan coast, take hostages and settle, while the Kipamu League is unable to resist.
timeline.quote: Keldon forces razed villages, captured hostages, and established a permanent settlement

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi sends Barrin to reorganize the League, working with Mageta, Rayne and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: was dispatched by planeswalker Teferi to reorganize the League's forces

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rayne discovers Greel is the source of the Phyrexian plague and Greel kills her.
timeline.quote: Greel confronted and killed Rayne

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin dissolves Greel with a spark spell and then executes the crushed Latulla.
timeline.quote: Barrin used a cascading spark spell to dissolve Greel into minute parts, killing him.

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Embittered Barrin and shaken Teferi turn away from Urza's plan.
timeline.quote: began to withdraw from Urza’s coalition

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wasitora learns she is a nekoru, wins the contest of nekoru, declares herself queen and chooses Mayonako, then decides to raise her kittens away from her kind.
timeline.quote: Wasitora proves herself the strongest female and declares herself their queen.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Who Is Queen? , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A column gives background on the Suq'Ata, their origins on Rabiah the Infinite and their organisation in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: their origins on the plane of Rabiah the Infinite

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "The Assassins of Suq'Ata". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Zhalfir becomes its own plane, leaving Jamuraa without its former glory.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Zhalfir would become its own plane

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sidar Kondo is killed by his own son Vuel, consumed by envy.
timeline.quote: Kondo died by his own son's hands.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jhoira sails to Suq'Ata to find a potential crew member.
timeline.quote: she took her barque to the coast of Jamuraa first, to the city of Suq'Ata

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
timeline.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
timeline.quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Arcades's army fights Bolas on Jamuraa until Ugin appears; Arcades uses the distraction to retreat.
timeline.quote: their battle was interrupted by Ugin 's appearance

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Breathstealers aid Kaervek's attempt to conquer Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: The Breathstealers aided the dark mage Kaervek in his attempt to conquer

citation.text: "Breathstealers", section "Activities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A religious dispute over the Shadow Creed's treatment of the dead leads the church to secede from Zhalfir and found Femeref.
timeline.quote: an internal religious dispute led the church to secede

citation.text: "Femeref", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suq'Ata Empire annexes lands and mines the mountains, pushing dwarves into Femeref, which welcomes them.
timeline.quote: The empire annexed the lands bordering Zhalfir and began to mine the mountains

citation.text: "Femeref", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: The land of Zhalfir was phased out by Teferi Planeswalker during the Phyrexian Invasion.

citation.text: "Femeref", section "The Zhalfirin Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Zhalfirin time rift, dooming Zhalfir to non-existence.
timeline.quote: the Zhalfirin time rift was sealed by Jeska without Teferi's guidance

citation.text: "Femeref", section "The Zhalfirin Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flash floods nearly wipe out the hill tribes of Tirras, whose land turns fertile.
timeline.quote: Almost wiped out in flash floods

citation.text: "Flooding of Terisiare", section "Flooding elsewhere". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael helps defend northern Jamuraa from the Keldons in the Prophecy War.
timeline.quote: Jolrael helped to defend the land, using her skills with the native beasts to gain an upper hand against Keldon raiders.

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla is placed in command of the Prophecy War and takes the captive Kipamu officer Haddad as her slave.
timeline.quote: she took the captive Kipamu officer Haddad as her slave

citation.text: "Latulla", section "Rise to fame". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla's counterattack against the Kipamu League fails; pinned under a war barge, she is decapitated by Barrin, who she mistook for a slave.
timeline.quote: Barrin, enraged by Rayne 's death, instead decapitated her

citation.text: "Latulla", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mageta and Barrin lead counterattacks; Mageta fights Latulla's last attempt and routs the Keldons.
timeline.quote: When Latulla made the last attempt to defeat the Kipamu League in battle Mageta once again led his troops from the front line.

citation.text: "Mageta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Prophecy", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The city-states of Jamuraa form the Kipamu League and repulse the invaders.
timeline.quote: The city-states of Jamuraa form the Kipamu League and then repulse the invaders.

citation.text: "Prophecy", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons are defeated and their colonies destroyed; Rayne, Latulla, Greel and Haddad die, and Barrin and Teferi begin to question their roles.

citation.text: "Prophecy (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
